title: Keep wagons, features and WMBTs at their canonical plan paths

facts.note: Every file outside vendored/generated trees is a discovery candidate regardless of suffix (.yaml, .yml or any other), so declarations with a noncanonical suffix or outside plan_root are still found and handed to the content classifier. plan_root (from the `topology:` settings in atdd-bun.yaml, default `plan`) defines the canonical target, not the discovery scope.
Needs a classifier that recognises a document as a wagon, feature or WMBT declaration by content, whatever its path or filename suffix, including existing documents that were never moved.
The atdd_topology validator emits a finding naming the canonical path; it applies to every declaration, existing or new.

fires: An existing wagon declaration sits somewhere other than `<plan_root>/<wagon>/_<wagon>.yaml`.
A wagon, feature or WMBT declaration is stored with a noncanonical suffix, e.g. `<plan_root>/<wagon>/_<wagon>.yml`.
A new or relocated wagon declaration is written somewhere other than `<plan_root>/<wagon>/_<wagon>.yaml`.
A feature declaration is outside its wagon directory, outside plan_root, or nested deeper than `<plan_root>/<wagon>/<feature>.yaml`.
A WMBT document is at a path other than `<plan_root>/<wagon>/<WMBT>.yaml`.
The topology validator reports a plan-location finding.
doesNotFire: A wagon, feature or WMBT document that already sits at its canonical `.yaml` path.
Files whose content is not a wagon, feature or WMBT declaration, whatever their suffix.
Source or test files under source_root/test_root (covered by the source-location and test-location rules).

given: A wagon, feature or WMBT declaration exists or is being written anywhere in the repository outside vendored/generated trees, with any filename suffix
when: its location is checked or the document is written
then: Every such declaration must be at its canonical path: wagon at `<plan_root>/<wagon>/_<wagon>.yaml`, feature at `<plan_root>/<wagon>/<feature>.yaml`, WMBT at `<plan_root>/<wagon>/<WMBT>.yaml`.
prefer: On a finding, move the document to the path the finding names.
Resolve `<plan_root>` from the `topology:` settings in atdd-bun.yaml (default `plan`) rather than hard-coding a directory.
avoid: Keeping a second plan layout alongside the canonical one in the same repository.
Placing plan documents at ad-hoc paths and relying on identity lookup alone to find them.
unless: Vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) are never scanned.
why: The plan is navigated by path as much as by identity. A document at a non-canonical path is found by nothing that walks the layout, and two layouts in one repository make every tool guess.
evidence: The atdd_topology validator reports no atdd-bun.topology.plan-location finding.
Every wagon, feature and WMBT document resolves to its canonical path under the configured plan_root.
verifier_detail: Canonical paths: wagon `<plan_root>/<wagon>/_<wagon>.yaml`; feature `<plan_root>/<wagon>/<feature>.yaml`; WMBT `<plan_root>/<wagon>/<WMBT>.yaml`. Applies to every declaration, existing or new, wherever found; discovery is by content, not by suffix, so a declaration with a `.yml` or other noncanonical suffix is a finding.
plan_root is read from the `topology:` key `plan_root` in atdd-bun.yaml, default `plan`.
Findings must name the canonical target path (fix hint: move the document to the path the finding names).
Severity 3, disposition strict: this is a package rule and it is strict (source statement: 'Package rule, strict.'); every finding fails.
audit: Provenance: source statement 'Package rule, strict.' — this rule is a package rule (atdd-bun.*) with strict disposition; realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node.

sharedNodes.text: Strict disposition: the rule fails on every finding; there is no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

package_rule: a rule of this package's own gates (`atdd-bun.*`), realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node. It is held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture, relationship edges.

additions.text: Activation facts, fires/doesNotFire examples, and the observer note for classifying plan documents by content anywhere in the repository regardless of filename suffix.
additions.justification: Required by the output structure; derived from the statement (every declaration must be at its canonical .yaml path), the exception (vendored/generated trees) and graph edges (source-/test-location rules cover other roots).

additions.text: Evidence items stating that the validator reports no finding and paths resolve canonically.
additions.justification: Source names the validator but not explicit compliance evidence; these restate the statement as a check.

additions.text: Discovery by content rather than suffix, so noncanonical suffixes such as .yml are findings.
additions.justification: Needed so the universal obligation is not narrowed by a suffix filter (auditor finding); it restates the canonical .yaml path requirement, adds no new obligation.
